dialogues.speaker: "Saurian Relics Association" Message Board
dialogues.text: "This is the Chuwen Fair branch of the Saurian Relics Association. We warmly invite you to explore the treasures of the age of the ancient dragons together with us!"

dialogues.speaker: "Saurian Relics Association" Message Board
dialogues.text: "This message board can be used for the posting of commissions or to exchange important information. Don't forget to check back frequently, there's usually something new to be learned!"
